text:
Release Bot: post-deploy smoke run finished for rollout v2026.03.23. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/3901234567 :eyes:
Maya: saw a couple of 503s in the sticky-session probe, can anyone confirm scope?
deploy-bot: synth-smoke: sticky-session-check failed on 3 hosts (east2), 503 xfer, 08:12UTC. Auto-retry scheduled in 30s.
Henry: I'm on east2 infra, seeing brief tcp conn resets during autoscaler churn, could be sticky sessions hitting backend churn.
Sanjay: can we pin routing to v2026.03.22 for the affected route while we investigate? That route only handles long-poll websockets.
Maya: prefer not a full rollback. Can we toggle sticky-session flag off for the new variant and re-run smoke?
QA Lead: grabbing logs from synth agent, posting snippet:
```
GET /health/sticky-session -> 503 {"error":"backend-reset"} host=10.12.8.7
Cookie: rds_session=v2026.03.23
```
Henry: confirmed, pod restarts on a few hosts coincided with the failures. Looks like session affinity metadata isn't propagated quickly when pods recycle.
Sanjay: plan: 1) deploy-bot pins traffic for route /ws/sticky to version v2026.03.22 (10%->100% for hotspot region east2) 2) ops toggles sticky-session=false on v2026.03.23 3) re-run smoke.
Maya: +1, do the minimal surface area change. If smoke passes we can reintroduce sticky-session with a slower ramp.
deploy-bot: executing: `redwood route pin --route /ws/sticky --to v2026.03.22 --region east2`
deploy-bot: pin complete. Traffic now routed to v2026.03.22 in east2. :white_check_mark:
QA Lead: toggled sticky-session=false on the v2026.03.23 variant (feature flag). Kicking off smoke rerun.
deploy-bot: synth-smoke rerun started (id: ss-3901234567-2)
QA Lead: second run results: 200/200 health probes passed, p95 latency 42ms. No 503s observed.
Maya: excellent. Ops, let's keep the pin for 30m while we monitor traces for any residual session affinity regressions.
Henry: I'll add a short-term fix to delay session metadata writes during pod termination and follow up tomorrow with a more robust propagation check.
Sanjay: opened a follow-up ticket: INF-9876 "session-affinity propagation on terminate" and linked smoke traces.
Release Bot: holding rollout. Pin in place for 30m. Notifying stakeholders in #deploy-notify.
Maya: thanks all. Patched plan: re-enable sticky-session with 10% ramp after 30m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
